robot: Mini Pupper v4 (SKU1), traced by hand with the servos limp

conventions.units: degrees from the stand pose (the calibrated neutral pose)
conventions.knee_fold: knee relative to the thigh, + = folding; the knee servo (inner coaxial output) must turn with the hip to hold a knee angle, so its limit is on the knee-thigh angle, not on the servo
conventions.track_end: the potentiometer's electrical track (310 deg) ends; a ~50 deg dead zone lies beyond. Not a mechanical stop, but positions there are unreadable: keep powered motion >= 20 deg inside. Depends on how each joint is mounted and calibrated
conventions.model_joint_range_rad: the same limits as joint ranges of the robot model (joints *_hip = abduction, *_calf = knee relative to the thigh), absolute angles (stand + measured range)

measured: the robot on its stand, the legs moved by hand with the servos limp, positions recorded at 200 Hz; each leg's own traces plus its left-right partner's traces mirrored (the partner's only inside the leg's own traced interval); the abduction and knee - thigh ranges are the robust extremes (reached in two adjacent 2-deg slices holding >= 50 clean samples, no margin), then the knee fold capped at +49 deg on every leg and each leg's abduction capped at the abduction stops marked by hand on that leg; the hip's stop towards the body's middle, as a function of the abduction, is in sku1_hip_envelope.json, capped at every thigh stop marked by hand and repaired where the clamp jumped more than 5 deg between columns
